question: Is the listed non-live validation sufficient to land this provider/browser/tooling dependency refresh, or should live provider/browser smoke output gate merge?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but dependency updates touch external provider SDKs and browser automation surfaces where unit tests and source inspection do not fully prove upgrade behavior.

options.title: Merge After Required Gates
options.body: Accept the residual dependency compatibility risk once required CI is green and the PR body's validation is trusted.

options.title: Ask For Live Smoke Evidence
options.body: Require a short live provider or browser smoke transcript before merge if this dependency refresh is release-critical.

recommendation.title: Merge After Required Gates
recommendation.body: Accept the residual dependency compatibility risk once required CI is green and the PR body's validation is trusted.
